moments.text: Title card 'zoomed in', then an infrared view down on white clouds. From 2.5 s a dark round spot drifts down-left along the top edge.
The dark round spot reappears upper left, crosses steadily to the right and slightly down, then vanishes beside a dark cloud patch.
Title card announces a sharpened, zoomed, tracked replay at 60% speed; a large dark spot then emerges below the black box at the top.
After fading into the clouds, the spot reappears and holds near the centre as clouds stream past, then merges into a dark cloud patch.
Black screen and title card 'Original Video', then the unzoomed footage: a smaller picture with black borders and a green crosshair over clouds.
A small dark dot appears at the top centre, drifts down and slightly left, then moves right and fades near a dark cloud patch.
